nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a partition of $n$ with multiplicity vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$, so that exactly $a_j$ parts of $p$ equal $j$ and $\sum_j j a_j = n$. For natural numbers $f_1, \dots, f_n$, the product of powers of $f$ over $p$ is the natural number $\prod_{j=1}^{n} f_j^{a_j}$.
nodes.title: Product of powers over a partition

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and a sequence $f \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, this is the natural number $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i)$.
nodes.title: Sum of the first n values of a sequence

nodes.summary: For a vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of natural numbers, this is the natural number $\sum_{j=1}^{n} a_j$.
nodes.title: Number of parts of an exponent vector

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and a sequence $g \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, this is the natural number $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} g(i)!\,\bigl((i+1)!\bigr)^{g(i)}$.
nodes.title: Factorial product of a sequence

nodes.summary: A vector $(a_0, \dots, a_{n-1})$ of natural numbers extends to the sequence $\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ that sends $j$ to $a_j$ for $j < n$ and to $0$ for $j \ge n$.

nodes.title: Generalized Stirling numbers of the second kind with parameter k

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a positive integer and let $p$ be a partition of $n$ with multiplicity vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$, so that exactly $a_j$ parts of $p$ equal $j$ and $\sum_j j a_j = n$. Write $S_2(k; j, 1)$ for the generalized Stirling numbers of the second kind with parameter $k$. The entry $\widehat{M}_{32}(k; p)$ is the natural number $\prod_{j=1}^{n} S_2(k; j, 1)^{a_j}$.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a partition of $n$ with multiplicity vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$, so that exactly $a_j$ parts of $p$ equal $j$ and $\sum_j j a_j = n$. The $M_3$ denominator of $p$ is the natural number $\prod_{j=1}^{n} a_j!\,(j!)^{a_j}$.
nodes.title: Denominator of the M3 partition number

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a partition of $n$ with multiplicity vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$, so that exactly $a_j$ parts of $p$ equal $j$ and $\sum_j j a_j = n$. The number $M_3(p)$ is the quotient of $n!$ by $\prod_{j=1}^{n} a_j!\,(j!)^{a_j}$ in natural-number division.
nodes.title: The M3 partition number

Write $M_3(p)$ for the M3 partition number of $p$, and for $j \ge 1$ write $c_j = (j + k - 2)!/(k - 1)!$, the absolute value of the generalized Stirling number of the first kind $S_1(k; j, 1)$. nodes.title: The partition number array $M_{32}(k)$

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and nonnegative integers $a_1, \dots, a_n$, the weighted size is $\sum_{j=1}^{n} j\,a_j$, the sum of the parts of the partition with $a_j$ parts equal to $j$.
nodes.title: Weighted size of a multiplicity vector

nodes.summary: Let $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ be a partition multiplicity vector of $n$, that is, nonnegative integers with $\sum_{j=1}^{n} j\,a_j = n$, where $a_j$ counts the parts equal to $j$. Its part count is $\sum_{j=1}^{n} a_j$.
nodes.title: Number of parts of a partition

nodes.summary: A partition multiplicity vector of $n \in \mathbb{N}$ is a tuple $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of nonnegative integers with $\sum_{j=1}^{n} j\,a_j = n$. It encodes the partition of $n$ that has $a_j$ parts equal to $j$.
nodes.title: Partition multiplicity vectors

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and functions $g, f \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, this is the product $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i)^{g(i)}$, with the convention $0^0 = 1$.
nodes.title: Finite power product

nodes.title: Absolute first column of the generalized Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.title: Index-weighted partial sum

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
